items.summary: fix(gateway): accept fenced JSON from the session observer model (#163878) Haiku-class utility models wrap the observer digest in a Markdown code fence, which the strict parser rejected twice and then disabled the observer for the run without saying why. Strip one surrounding fence before strict validation and include a redacted 160-character prefix of the last rejected reply in the failure, so health digests land on those Gateways and rejections are diagnosable from the journal.

items.title: refactor(node-host): consolidate command execution ownership (#163868)
items.summary: refactor(node-host): consolidate command execution ownership (#163868) Let system.run own policy defaults, environment sanitization, native socket routing, and lifecycle event formatting. Remove forwarded implementation callbacks, duplicate event types, and the single-use filesystem dispatcher. Preserve approval checks, event ordering, output tails, and Claude event suppression; keep execution and response adapters where behavior differs. Production LOC: +92/-254, net -162 across five files. Validation: 194 tests passed and one platform skip across nine files on AWS Linux; core and affected test types, targeted lint, and formatting passed. Same-host live local/node pong comparisons completed before and after. Codex autoreview found no actionable P0-P2 issues. Test cost (one worker): invoke 13.80s, system-run 10.35s, socket 11.02s, Claude 14.22s; siblings 25.84s. Initial cold invoke run included compiler preparation and took 34.70s. Commit hooks skipped with --no-verify only after pnpm exec oxfmt --check passed for all eight changed files on the validation lease; this sparse worktree has no node_modules.

items.title: refactor(gateway): move placement result settlement into workers (#16…
items.summary: refactor(gateway): move placement result settlement into workers (#163819) * refactor(gateway): move placement result settlement into workers Await workspace-result claims, acceptance, recovery handoff, draining, cancellation, and settlement through the existing placement dispatcher. Prepare revocable result facts with the placement read owner and publish acknowledged postimages before observers. Preserve exact physical-store and claim custody, atomic acceptance/journal cleanup, and conservative handling of unknown outcomes without filesystem rollback or write replay. Migrate runtime callers and cover caller-thread SQL, stale claims, commit-grant revocation, recovery, and publication ordering. No schema, retention, durability, or public SDK contract changes. * fix(plugins): preserve released placement context contracts Retain the synchronous placement readers and orphan-deferral completion shipped through the v2026.9.7 Gateway plugin context. Add deprecated compatibility records and awaited Async companions, migrate internal callers, and prove the public return types and synchronous effects. * fix(tooling): include placement compatibility reader imports Keep the extracted PR wrapper closed over the restored synchronous result readers. Add the 15 transitive modules reported by the inventory and extracted package-resolution checks; both boundary checks pass after reproducing the failures in five runs. * test(plugins): assert released gateway context equality Check each released SDK context entry point explicitly while preserving the synchronous return-type and awaited companion assertions. This avoids duplicate union constituents; type-aware lint, focused type checking, and the complete repair changed-file gates pass.

items.title: OpenAI調查失控AI代理人活動，已通知逾100個組織
items.summary: OpenAI周三（9/30）公布AI代理人未對齊行為的最新調查進度，指出截至9月26日，已就相關異常活動通知超過100個組織，目前仍在持續回溯歷史紀錄，預期還會發現更多案例。 這項調查源於OpenAI先前發現內部研究模型入侵Hugging Face的事件。OpenAI之後擴大檢查模型在訓練及評估期間的網路活動，尋找是否還有其他代理人在執行任務時偏離原本目的，或以未預期方式與第三方網站及服務互動。目前調查已進行約一個月，尚未發現其他事件的規模或嚴重程度達到Hugging Face事件。
